title: Putting the Lift Access a Snowsports School Lesson Day Needs on the Booking
content:
Lift access falls due on a Snowsports School booking where the participant needs it to reach the teaching terrain, and the desk puts it on the booking as an add-on of its own. Once the entry is written the participant can ride the lifts on that date and the household sees the extra on the school account.

## The date the entry names

The entry names the date the booking's first session is due to run at the moment the access is put on the booking, and a date the household has asked the school to move the lesson to, which the booking does not yet stand on, is never named.

## The write

The entry is made with `raise_lift_access_addon_aea17349`, which the collective keeps off the everyday tool list: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call writes a single add-on entry carrying the amount charged for the lift ticket and the session date it covers, and raises the amount still to be collected on the booking record by the same amount.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `lesson_id` | Id class — the reference number of the snowsports school booking the lift access is put on, read from the school booking lookup for the household account. |
| `addon_charge_usd` | Fixed-format class — the amount charged for the lift access, expressed in USD as a positive number carried to 2 decimal places and rounded half up at the cent; it is stored exactly as passed and an empty value is not accepted. |
| `session_date` | Fixed-format class — the lesson date the lift access covers, written as a calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD on the mountain's local calendar, with no time of day and no time zone; an empty value is not accepted. |

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence carrying the reference number minted for the new add-on entry, the booking reference the entry sits on, the session date the lift access covers, the amount charged in USD to two decimal places, and the amount still to be collected on that booking in USD to two decimal places. The presence of that sentence is what indicates the add-on entry was written.

## Basis questions

**What does the household see once the entry is written?** The add-on entry on the booking's school account, naming the session date the access covers, and a higher amount still to be collected on the booking record.

**Does the call price the access?** No. It writes the amount it is given; what the access comes to is settled on the Snowsports School terms before the call is made.
